notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]A new patch is live![/h1]*

The star is a Steering Sensitivity slider added conveniently to the Pause menu which now controls both digital [i]and[/i] analog sensitivity. Just Pause, adjust to taste, and keep on keepin' on ^_^

Other changes since launch:
[list]
[*] Controls panel rearranged a bit to more clearly show Analog and Digital mappings for both Keyboard and current controller/wheel (separate steering page)
[*] Pause menu now has all in-game settings available without having to go to a separate Settings/Options page
[*] NPC headlights dimmed slightly
[*] Resolution menu now re-scans current display resolutions every time you enter it
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

[b]A big thanks goes to the community for the suggestions that resulted in these improvements![/b]

If you have any other ideas on features or quality-of-life improvements for the game, let us know here or head over to [url=https://discord.gg/2T5WmhS]our Discord[/url] to discuss!


* [i]You may need to restart Steam for the patch to download.[/i]

notes.title: Nightvision: Drive Forever launches today!
notes.notes:
The full version of Nightvision is available now!

[b]Nightvision: Drive Forever[/b] is an arcade driving experience unlike any other. Realistic handling meets frantic timed sprints across hazardous, procedurally generated roads. One mistake can lead to failure, and a spectacular car crash, so victory requires intense focus. With today's launch, you can now experience the world of Nightvision through its story mode; a tale of the risks we take for the ones we love. 

It also includes the Sandbox for crafting your own unique challenges to share with (and dare) friends, giving you [i]over 10 quintillion[/i] possible levels. Or just go for an easy, endless drive for a relaxing break.

Story mode progress also unlocks EPIC secret modes for Sandbox. Check em out!

[previewyoutube=KOOd4Yjfe4A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Get a taste of the limitless roads of Nightvision: Drive Forever
notes.notes:
The Nightvision demo is now available!

Nightvision is the first road-lite game combining an intense nighttime highway driving simulation with Roguelike elements such as randomly generated, endless levels. To begin with, all you know is that you need to get there fast, but the road is smooth and straight so that should be no problem, right? You're soon met with chaotically swerving roads, blind hills, inclement weather, retina-searing headlights, and more. If you fail a segment you can try again, but the road isn't quite how you remember it...   

Hone your driving skills, learn how to really push your humble car, and rely on your instincts, featuring the unique challenges of fast driving through a lonesome mountainscape, limited visibility, and no luxury of the same drive twice. Practice and enjoy an easy endless drive, or hand-craft your own blistering challenges to taunt your friends with in Sandbox Mode, giving you free rein to create over 10 quintillion different level variations.

The demo lets you try out the Sandbox with only one level seed (out of 1 billion) available, and some Road & World options are disabled such as time of day (still allowing several MILLION variations in the demo!). 

Wishlist now, and be among the first to experience Story Mode and all of the world generating possibilities available in the full game when it launches on October 13th!

Will you see the night through?

notes.title: WHEEL PROGRESS
notes.notes:
Hey Visionaries. 

v0.8.8b adds in an ENORMOUS controller update, [b]including full wheel support[/b]! Now you should be able to drive with anything ya got, from Fanatec to Logitech, Xbox to Dual Shock, Joy-Con to SNES, and everything in between... it all should Just Work™. Anything REALLY odd you have laying around can be mapped manually however you please.

In other news: Features and bug-fixes intensify, Story Mode content is coming along nicely, and I'm finishing up the rest of the original soundtrack as we get closer to the FALL LAUNCH

Did I mention the soundtrack will be available separately or as a bundle?

Stay tuned, and if you can't wait until the Fall Steam Game Festival to play the game, be sure to join [url=https://discord.gg/2T5WmhS]our Discord[/url] sharpish ;)

notes.title: Demo Ending July 17th
notes.notes:
Hi Visionaries, heads-up that the demo will be taken down this Friday. We're happy we extended the Steam Game Festival demo to an entire month... We had a blast hearing your thoughts on the game so far. Thank you for being a part of Nightvision!

[b]WHAT NOW?![/b]

Glad you asked, because we have good news: [url=https://discord.gg/2T5WmhS]Head over to our Discord[/url] to stay in the loop and [b]get in on the FULL BETA TEST coming next month[/b], chock full of content and no demo restrictions! (seems fair, right?)

Speaking of content, work continues on Story Mode, the original soundtrack, basic in-game tutorial/help (via your friendly center console screen), new Secret Modes and more! 

But you might miss it if you're not on Discord...

Stay tuned.

- hoo

notes.title: BIG UPDATE: v0.8b is live!
notes.notes:
Happy 4th of July, Visionaries! Nightvision v0.8b is live!

BIG UPDATE: 
- Discord integration now shows driving state, elapsed drive time, and current passphrase.
- Cloud shadows fixed.
- Fixed bug where a hole in the ground would sometimes appear along the edge of the road.
- NPC (non-player car) psychopathic tendencies reduced somewhat.
- Stopped spawning new NPCs after crash/too-slow fail.
- Fixed misaligned volume sliders (no idea how those moved... spooky!).
- Fixed ultra-rare bug where falling through the ground meant falling through time and space forever.
- Fixed misaligned stats-screen menu.
- New fail condition for Rainbow Road (secret mode).
- AI waypoint recycling (in pursuit of truly infinite Endless Mode).
- [Non-Demo Beta] Secret Visual Styles/Modes now available.
- Improved a thing I can't tell you about. :P
- Minor performance optimizations.
- Many other small bug fixes and tweaks.
